tile.name: PDF viewer
tile.desc: Open a PDF from the file drop, on a phone too

addon.title: PDF viewer
addon.summary: Mozilla's PDF.js, running in the visitor's browser, with the file drop's PDFs as its start page. It opens a PDF in place on a phone, where the browser's own viewer would download it. It needs about 25 MB of storage. It is adapted for the box: its start page is the drop, and a strict Content-Security-Policy stops every request outside the box.
addon.consent: This downloads PDF.js from github.com/mozilla/pdf.js at the release that this hub pins. A new web add-on starts disabled. After you enable it, the hub serves it to the visitors that its Access setting lets open it. The copy is adapted for the box: the start page lists the PDFs in the file drop, and a strict Content-Security-Policy stops every request outside the box. Add the PDF viewer?
